introduction:
In Rajasthan, the Jati Praman Patra (Caste Certificate) is an official document that certifies an individual's caste category. This certificate is crucial for obtaining reservation benefits, academic admissions, and government jobs under the SC, ST, OBC, and SBC categories.

The application for an OBC (State Level) Caste Certificate is typically processed digitally via the E-Mitra Portal (emitra.rajasthan.gov.in) using a hybrid method of offline verification followed by online kiosk submission.
quickFacts:
Quick Facts & Key Details
  • Service: Application for Caste Certificate (OBC - State Level) / Jati Praman Patra
  • State: Rajasthan
  • Portal Used: E-Mitra Portal (typically accessed by kiosk operators)
  • Primary ID Required: Jan Aadhaar Card (mandatory for auto-fetching details)
  • Application Fee: ₹50 (Token fee)
  • Processing Authority: Revenue Department (Tehsil Office)
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Note: Original documents must be scanned as PDFs before uploading them online via the E-Mitra portal.
Primary ID & Address Proof
  • Jan Aadhaar Card: Mandatory for auto-fetching applicant profile details.
  • Address Proof: Ration Card, Voter ID, Bonafide Certificate, Water/Electricity Bill, or Passport.
  • Education Proof: 10th standard mark sheet or equivalent (optional if uneducated).
Verification Forms & Caste Proofs
  • Application Form: Completely filled and signed physical application form.
  • Patwari Report: Report from local Patwari (crucial to verify caste lineage and residence).
  • Affidavit: Standard declaration/affidavit signed by the applicant or guardian.
  • Other Documents: Father's old caste certificate and Income Proof (required for OBC Non-Creamy Layer).
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Step-by-Step Online Application (via E-Mitra Kiosk)

This method demonstrates the application process on the E-Mitra portal, which is the standard digital upload mechanism in Rajasthan:

  1. Prepare Scans: Fill out the physical offline application form, get it verified by the Patwari, gather all proofs, and scan them into PDF format.
  2. Log in to E-Mitra: Access the E-Mitra dashboard using login credentials.
  3. Select Caste Service: Navigate to Services > Avail Application Service from the left menu. Search for "OBC" and select "Application form for Caste Certificate - OBC for State".
  4. Fetch Profile: Enter the applicant's Jan Aadhaar Number and click "Get Details".
  5. Verify OTP: Select the family member applying and click "Verify". Enter the OTP sent to the registered mobile number.
  6. Review Auto-Fetched Details: The portal auto-fetches basic details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' Names) from the Jan Aadhaar database (these cannot be edited).
  7. Fill Caste Details: Scroll down and fill in Title, Birthplace, Marital Status, Religion, Caste Category (Other Backward Class), and Sub-caste.
  8. Demographic Questions: Answer "Are you a native of Rajasthan?" (Yes) and "Do you belong to the Creamy Layer?" (No, if applying for Non-Creamy Layer).
  9. Fill Address: Input the current address details (District, Tehsil, Gram Panchayat, Village, Pincode). Check the box if permanent address is the same as current. Click Save.
  10. Enter Income: Fill in the total Annual Family Income and select the respective financial year. Click Save.
  11. Upload Enclosures: Under the Document Upload section, choose Address Proof (e.g. Ration Card), enter card details, click Choose File, and click Add. Repeat the process to add Educational Qualification, Application Form, Affidavit, and other supporting documents. Ensure all uploads are PDFs.
  12. Save Application: Once all files are listed, click Save. The application is forwarded to the local Tehsil Revenue Office.
  13. Pay Fee: Click Proceed to Pay / Bill Payment. Pay the ₹50 fee using E-Mitra Wallet or UPI/QR Code.
  14. Print Receipt: Upon successful payment, print the receipt for your application record.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Offline Application Process

Follow the standard offline procedure to prepare your application form before submitting it to the authorities:

  1. Obtain Form: Visit your local Tehsil Office, SDM Office, or E-Mitra kiosk to collect the physical Jati Praman Patra application form, or download it from the official portal.
  2. Fill Details: Fill in all fields manually with accurate personal, caste, and income information.
  3. Patwari Verification: Have the designated section of the form verified and signed by your local Patwari or Tehsildar (this serves as the official background check).
  4. Attach Proofs: Attach photocopies of all required enclosures (Jan Aadhaar, Aadhaar, Ration Card, Educational certificates, Income proof, and Affidavit).
  5. Submission: Submit the compiled application set directly at the Tehsil/SDM office counter, or hand it over to an E-Mitra kiosk operator to upload it digitally on your behalf (as shown in Method 1).
afterApplying:
After Submitting & Tracking Application

Track Application

From the E-Mitra dashboard, navigate to Services > Service Workflow for Application Services. Select your application date range and click Submit to view the current status (e.g., "Application Submitted", "Pending at Tehsil", or "Approved").

Certificate Issuance

Once verified and approved by the Tehsil Revenue Department, your digital caste certificate is generated and can be downloaded or printed directly from the portal.
